description: React component for managing AI provider credentials, including listing, adding, updating, and deleting credentials with modal dialogs and API calls.

classes.name: CredentialsPanel
classes.description: React functional component for displaying and managing credentials for AI providers.

methods.name: handleUpdateCredential
methods.description: Handles updating a credential by calling API and refetching data.

methods.name: handleAddCredential
methods.description: Handles adding a new credential via API and refetching data.

methods.name: renderProviderBadge
methods.description: Returns a badge component with color based on provider name.

methods.name: handleDeleteCredential
methods.description: Deletes a credential via API and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: openDeleteModal
methods.description: Opens modal to confirm credential deletion.
